open_obligations.what_is_open: A worst-case bit-complexity bound polynomial in n, the encoded input length, and the inverse threshold tolerance for the branch-and-bound certificate over both continuous Lipschitz profile classes.
open_obligations.obstruction: The certified pruning invariant supplies only a Lipschitz oscillation bound.  It gives neither a polynomial bound on the number of profile boxes that can straddle the acceptance boundary nor a separation margin from that boundary.  In the worst case an arbitrarily large family of boxes can remain undecided at the required outward precision, so the exhaustive termination proof does not imply polynomial bit complexity.
open_obligations.attempted: Discretize the profiles on the time mesh, use the common-Poisson Lipschitz modulus to prune boxes, dovetail directed convolution refinements, and binary-search the threshold grid.  These steps prove computability and output validity, but the covering number of the functional Lipschitz classes and boundary-straddling boxes is not controlled polynomially by the frozen primitives.
